Hillview Animal Park has released tickets for their 2026 PUP-kin patch session.

It will involve pumpkin picking fun for the entire family with a maximum of two dogs coming per booking.

There will also be marshmallow toasting, a display of giant pumpkins, photo opportunities and kids Halloween themed games.
